from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data for a single company from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="The securities code if provided, e.g., 002676")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024 Q1'")
    net_profit_amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="The net profit amount as a number; losses should be negative")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the financial figure, e.g., 'CNY', '元'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: List[CompanyFinancialReport]
